title: Native ternary export: physical bytes and output parity before the iPad port
question: Does physically packing native C's ternary projections preserve their codes and outputs, and store at most 45% of the fp32-master file bytes?
hypothesis: Two-bit packing is lossless for the already-quantised ternary projections. With identical fp32 attention/embedding tensors, this C fixture should store less than 0.45 times its fp32 master checkpoint. This is a format hypothesis, not a language-quality hypothesis.

data.audit: 64 evenly spaced validation segments of 128 next-byte predictions, 8,192 target bytes; no training or test-set selection

setup.hardware: free x86 CPU only; record available CPUs, PyTorch version and thread count

packed-format.baseline: same seeded untrained native C model with fp32 master parameters and normal BitLinear execution
packed-format.treatment: pack its ternary FFN codes plus scales; keep other tensors identical; reload and unpack one projection at a time

analysis.primary: All four format checks must pass for every seed. Report mean, sample SD and 95% Student-t CI using lab.stats; decide with lab.gate.
analysis.secondary: Actual file and tensor-payload bytes; unfused decode tokens/s; existing native.bench projection and same-active-FLOP MoE timings. Timings are descriptive, with no speed gate or forecast.
analysis.provenance: Record code commit, prereg SHA-256, corpus hash, checkpoint hashes, hardware and all seeds. No best-seed selection.
analysis.stopping: No dimension or gate changes after the first audit run. Failures remain in results; a corrected protocol needs a new ID. Interrupted runs may resume only with the same code/prereg.

kill: Any format check fails: block this exporter from the device phase. A PASS licenses only a format claim, not a quality, memory-residency, speed, energy or iPad claim.

expected_effect.source: R1.29b report: 14,853 KiB analytically packed versus 38,852 KiB fp32 at 9.95M parameters; no physical packed-file or device result in that report
expected_effect.forecast: File-size reduction expected by encoding construction; its magnitude for this different fixture is unmeasured before this run. CPU speed and joules/token are unknown.

device_followup.status: blocked on trained finalist/checkpoint, backend and real iPad; requires a separately committed registration before measurements
device_followup.selection: No C/D winner exists until Level B has a valid A baseline and the tournament's pre-registered gates finish. Fix the selected checkpoint hash and matched full-precision comparator before the device phase.
device_followup.formats: 1,000,000,000-byte and 5,000,000,000-byte physical weight/tokenizer budgets, including scales and metadata; adapters and retrieved documents reported separately. CPU reference is not GGUF/CoreML.
device_followup.quality: Frozen validation BPB and held-out math/logic/code, plus 4k/32k passkey; seeds 1/2/3. Quantised minus matched full-precision BPB <= +0.02 and task accuracy loss <= 2 percentage points. Exported versus training-format logits checked independently.
device_followup.device: Identify iPad model, chip, 8/16 GB configuration, OS/backend versions. Batch 1, contexts 512/4096/32768, 256 generated tokens, 3 sessions with 5 repetitions/context, 30-minute sustained thermal run.
device_followup.measurement: Prefill/decode tokens/s and p95 latency; iOS process resident/peak memory including KV, workspaces and transient dequantisation; actual kernel placement. Calibrated external USB-C power trace at fixed battery charge, screen/brightness and temperature; idle trace subtracted. Report gross and incremental J/token, sensor uncertainty and sustained watts. Do not use a Mac or a process RSS proxy as an iPad energy measurement.
device_followup.proposed_gates: Quality gates above, >=10 sustained decode tokens/s, <=2 incremental J/token, <=30 W gross during the measurement, app resident memory <=6 GB on 8 GB and <=12 GB on 16 GB. These are design targets, not observed effects; freeze in the device registration and disclose any target change before data collection.
device_followup.paid_compute: Only via the existing rouge-gpu approval path; this registration authorises no paid GPU.

not_claimed: No learning, trained-model quality, knowledge capacity, runtime memory savings, Metal/CoreML compatibility, MatMul-free execution, or iPad energy. PackedLinear expands a projection and calls a dense matmul.
